System: Team Wendy LTP Bump

Model: 72-R3 Series

Configuration: Exfil LTP Bump

Description:

Team Wendy Exfil LTP Bump Helmet is constructed

from an extremely lightweight and durable polymer to

provide lightweight non-ballistic protection. CAM

FIT™ Retention System with easily adjustable Cam

Lock sliders and a micro-adjustable BOA Fit System.

Suitable for any environment, including maritime.

Integrated shroud with an aluminum shroud insert for

added stability and ruggedness.

Vented airflow allows for headset to be worn

underneath.
